title: Change Only the Ending
tests: Resolves 'the ending' to the final three seconds of the previous video and edits that segment while preserving the opening.

faults.what: The delivered clip is five seconds long instead of eight, omitting the requested final three-second landing sequence.
The plane remains airborne in all supplied frames; no landing or resting position on the open notebook is shown.

judge.summary: The clip shows a white paper plane gliding through a sunny study toward an open notebook, but it is only five seconds long and does not show the requested landing.

must_haves.item: The output is one eight-second 16:9 video with no audio.
must_haves.why: One 16:9 video is supplied, but its reported duration is five seconds, not eight. The audio report is near-silent at -91 dB, although it also supplies a speech transcription.

must_haves.item: The first five seconds visually match the previous video's opening, rather than a newly staged flight.
must_haves.why: The previous video is not provided for comparison.

must_haves.item: During the final three seconds, the same white paper plane lands on an open notebook on the wooden desk.
must_haves.why: The required seconds five through eight are absent. The latest supplied frame shows the plane still airborne above the desk.

must_haves.item: The plane comes to rest on the notebook rather than directly on the bare desk.
must_haves.why: An open blank notebook is visible on the wooden desk, but the output does not show the plane coming to rest on it.

must_haves.item: The sunny study and animation style remain consistent across the edit, and no text appears.
must_haves.why: The supplied frames consistently show a warmly sunlit study with no visible text, but consistency with the previous video and the missing revised ending cannot be verified.
